text:
Aisha: quick weekly check-in for Helio Labs — seeing some odd signals on token ingest and throughput. TL;DR: WoW tokens down, QoQ up; latency spike mid-day; spend ticked up. Flagging for ops + enablement.

Aisha: quick numbers snapshot — please skim: 
```
metric | last_week | this_week | change
tokens | 480k | 423k | -11.8%
p50_ms | 120 | 210 | +75%
5xx_rate | 0.12% | 0.90% | +0.78pp
spend $ | 18.2k | 19.8k | +8.8%
```

Aisha: note: latency jump concentrated 10:00-13:00 PST yesterday; batch sizes increased, KV hit rate dipped. @Miguel can you triage? Also @Jian, curious if this should be a renewal-watch item.

Miguel: on it — pulling request-level logs and batching windows now. looks like a sudden tail of long-seq requests. scheduling a quick 30m huddle at 10:30 PT. will invite Nate for raw pulls. :mag_right:

Nate: pushed the ad-hoc query results to a gist: https://gist.github.com/helio-labs-check/placeholder (will replace with CSV). quick findings: ~67% of this week's tokens originated from 3 clients on Helio; one client shows a shift to sequences >1024 tokens around the same time window.

Miguel: initial guess = workload shift -> bigger KV miss + larger batches -> p50 jump. will run KV hit-rate by model-variant and prefix cache hit.

Priya: propose an enablement play: short enablement for Helio devs on prompt windowing + response truncation and suggested quant profiles. I can prep a 20-min session and some one-pagers.

Jian: renewal perspective: usage down WoW but spend up is noisy — account-health score for Helio drops from 74 -> 62 this check. recommend CS owner keep this as a watch and escalate if another regression next week. can we set auto-escalation at delta >10pp? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Anomaly-detection alert AD-4421: correlated model-variant fallback events and increased latency between 2024-09-12T10:05Z and 2024-09-12T12:55Z.

Miguel: noted, will check fallback logs + model-variant selector policy for that window. adding there might have been a capacity-induced fallback to a slower quantized variant.

Aisha: action items we agreed: 
- Miguel + Nate: deep-dive and post findings + raw CSV by EOD today.
- Priya: schedule enablement session for Helio next Tue (20m + one-pager).
- Jian: mark renewal-risk = "watch" for now; CS owner to escalate if health <=60 next check.

Aisha: will follow up with a short summary in #customer-success tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:
